caption:
can one laser session clear melasma?

Probably not. In the trials, melasma was treated over 2 to 12 sessions, spaced 1 to 4 weeks apart.

One trip or several? One word below.

That range comes from a review of 16 randomized trials, 471 people (doi:10.1111/jocd.70602). A larger network meta-analysis, 39 trials and 1,394 people, found that one common laser plus a topical treatment did better than the same laser alone (doi:10.1111/jocd.16006).

If you're travelling for skin, a 5-day visit doesn't match how melasma was treated in those studies. And the cream part happens at home, every day.

What this doesn't mean: that lasers don't help, or that everyone needs 12. The number depends on the person and the device.

Send this to a friend planning laser sessions.

General education only. Melasma needs to be diagnosed in person.
